description: PROGRESSIVE FINETUNING V2: ANRI → DIBCO with FIXED VALIDATION. Critical fixes from v1: (1) Use EXISTING mixed_stage1 file for ANRI validation (not non-existent anri_real_data.tfrecord), (2) ADD dibco_tiled_full.tfrecord for DIBCO validation (MISSING in v1!), (3) Properly measure all 3 domains. Same training dataset as v1 (no ANRI = catastrophic forgetting expected), but NOW we can measure if DIBCO actually improved. Goal: Answer critical question - did we gain DIBCO performance despite losing ANRI?

critical_fixes_from_v1: FIX 1: anri_tfrecord changed from 'anri_real_data.tfrecord' (NOT EXIST) to 'mixed_stage1_70base_30anri.tfrecord' (EXISTS)
FIX 3: Added monitor_dibco_psnr = true (v1 claimed triple validation but only had dual)

v1_failures.dibco_not_measured: Config claimed triple validation but DIBCO validation missing
v1_failures.cannot_answer_research_question: Unknown if DIBCO improved - main objective not verified

v2_improvements.measurement_fix: NOW measures all 3 domains (Base, ANRI, DIBCO)
v2_improvements.data_rehearsal: NO - same as v1 (0% ANRI in training dataset)

training_dataset_composition.note: SAME AS V1 - ANRI NOT in training (catastrophic forgetting will occur)

anri_validation.note: Using MIXED dataset as proxy for ANRI (contains 30% ANRI)

dibco_validation.purpose: CRITICAL: Measure if DIBCO actually improved!
dibco_validation.expected: UNKNOWN - this is what we need to find out!
dibco_validation.success_criteria: ≥30 dB = success, 28-30 dB = marginal, <28 dB = failure

progressive_finetuning_strategy.approach: Sequential domain adaptation WITH proper measurement

stage2_v1_result.issue: Cannot verify if progressive finetuning achieved its goal

progressive_finetuning_strategy.stage2_v2_goal: Measure DIBCO PSNR to determine if trade-off worthwhile

experiment_metadata.research_question: Does progressive finetuning (ANRI → DIBCO) improve DIBCO performance enough to justify ANRI catastrophic forgetting (-5.5 dB)?

strategy.validation: TRIPLE validation (Base + ANRI + DIBCO) - NOW ACTUALLY IMPLEMENTED!

safety.note: ANRI red line will likely trigger (no data rehearsal)

expected_outcome_v2.dibco_psnr: WILL BE MEASURED (critical missing data from v1)

if_dibco_excellent.assessment: Progressive finetuning SUCCESS despite ANRI loss
if_dibco_excellent.next_action: Accept trade-off OR try v3 with data rehearsal for best of both

if_dibco_marginal.assessment: Questionable trade-off (lost ANRI -5.5 dB, gained DIBCO +2 dB)
if_dibco_marginal.next_action: Try v3 with data rehearsal (50% Base + 30% DIBCO + 20% ANRI)

if_dibco_poor.assessment: Complete failure (lost ANRI, didn't gain DIBCO)
if_dibco_poor.next_action: Abandon progressive finetuning, use separate DIBCO model

v3_plan_if_needed.approach: Data rehearsal to prevent catastrophic forgetting
v3_plan_if_needed.training_dataset: NEW mixed dataset: 50% Base + 30% DIBCO + 20% ANRI
v3_plan_if_needed.expected: Base ~30.5 dB, ANRI ~32 dB (preserved), DIBCO 29-31 dB
v3_plan_if_needed.note: Only proceed if v2 shows DIBCO PSNR ≥28 dB
